facts.subject: Passenger Information Gateway

facts.subject: Communications-Based Train Control system
facts.text: Cybersecurity controls for the Greenvale Metro Communications-Based Train Control System shall be treated as operating prerequisites for safe automatic train movement after any maintenance handback.

facts.subject: Cyber Security Officer
facts.text: The Cyber Security Officer shall maintain continuous monitoring of security events from the Safety Data Communication Network, the Wayside Radio Access Network, and the Metro Operations Control System.

facts.subject: null
facts.text: Security monitoring shall correlate authentication failures, session resets, rejected messages, configuration changes, and abnormal timing patterns without altering any safety command path.

facts.subject: Line Traffic Controller
facts.text: The Line Traffic Controller shall be notified when a cybersecurity event requires a restriction on automatic operation or a change in communications mode.

facts.subject: Cryptographic Key Management Appliance
facts.text: The Cryptographic Key Management Appliance shall be the controlled source for operational certificates used by trainborne, wayside, control center, and maintenance components.

facts.subject: null
facts.text: Certificate renewal shall be planned before expiry so that the Atlas Onboard Controller, Train Radio Modem, North District Zone Controller, South District Zone Controller, and West Junction Interlocking do not enter service with degraded trust.

facts.subject: East Junction Interlocking
facts.text: Falcon shall reject any control message with an invalid signature, an expired certificate, or a sequence value outside the accepted window.

facts.subject: Maintenance Diagnostic Server
facts.text: The Maintenance Diagnostic Server shall not be used to bypass certificate checks or to create alternate trust paths into safety-related communications.

facts.subject: Cryptographic Key Management Appliance
facts.text: Administrative access to the Cryptographic Key Management Appliance shall require named accounts, multifactor authentication, separation of duties, and recorded approval for privileged changes.

facts.subject: Cyber Security Officer
facts.text: The Cyber Security Officer shall approve security-sensitive permissions before they are enabled.

facts.subject: Revenue Train Operator
facts.text: The Revenue Train Operator shall not be assigned cybersecurity administration duties during passenger service, although security warnings presented in the cab shall remain part of normal operating awareness.

facts.subject: Service Timetable Server
facts.text: The Service Timetable Server and Passenger Information Gateway shall be monitored for compromise.

facts.subject: Voice Dispatch Console
facts.text: The Voice Dispatch Console shall be included in security incident procedures when a cyber event changes the normal method for issuing operational instructions.

facts.subject: Platform Screen Door Controller
facts.text: The Platform Screen Door Controller shall accept only authenticated interfaces approved for passenger service coordination and maintenance testing.

facts.subject: Dual Channel Odometer
facts.text: The Dual Channel Odometer and Atlas Onboard Controller shall report security-relevant diagnostic conditions in a manner that supports investigation without exposing cryptographic material.

facts.subject: null
facts.text: Commissioning shall begin only after the installed equipment baseline for the Atlas Onboard Controller, Dual Channel Odometer, Train Radio Modem, and wayside control equipment has been configuration checked against the approved release record.

facts.subject: Revenue Train Operator
facts.text: Each test train shall be crewed by a Revenue Train Operator qualified for commissioning duties and supported by a Line Traffic Controller with authority to stop the trial.

facts.subject: null
facts.text: Initial movements shall be conducted at restricted commissioning speeds and shall progress to representative service speeds only after the Atlas Onboard Controller and North District Zone Controller demonstrate stable supervision.

facts.subject: South District Zone Controller
facts.text: The South District Zone Controller shall be commissioned under the same test regime so that boundary behavior is verified before whole-line operation is attempted.

facts.subject: East Junction Interlocking
facts.text: East Junction Interlocking and West Junction Interlocking shall remain under enhanced monitoring during migration.

facts.subject: Safety Data Communication Network
facts.text: Before any cutover stage, the Safety Data Communication Network and Wayside Radio Access Network shall be verified for coverage, latency, redundancy, and alarm presentation at the control center.

facts.subject: Platform Screen Door Controller
facts.text: The Platform Screen Door Controller shall be included in end-to-end tests that confirm safe coordination between platform equipment, train stopping position, and supervised door enablement.

facts.subject: Service Timetable Server
facts.text: The Service Timetable Server shall provide trial schedules that exercise normal headways, recovery margins, terminal reversals, and junction conflicts without carrying passengers.

facts.subject: Passenger Information Gateway
facts.text: The Passenger Information Gateway shall be observed during operational rehearsal to confirm that public-facing messages remain consistent with the planned commissioning condition.

facts.subject: Voice Dispatch Console
facts.text: Voice Dispatch Console procedures shall be rehearsed for test-train dispatch, abnormal stop instructions, evacuation coordination, and return to depot instructions.

facts.subject: Maintenance Diagnostic Server
facts.text: The Maintenance Diagnostic Server shall collect commissioning diagnostics so that intermittent radio, odometry, controller, and interlocking events can be reviewed before acceptance.

facts.subject: Cryptographic Key Management Appliance
facts.text: The Cryptographic Key Management Appliance shall be confirmed as available, synchronized with the approved security baseline, and capable of supporting commissioning operations without manual workarounds.

facts.subject: Signal Maintenance Engineer
facts.text: A Signal Maintenance Engineer shall verify that field defects raised during test running have been closed, deferred with approved controls, or assigned to a post-commissioning monitoring plan.

facts.subject: Cyber Security Officer
facts.text: A Cyber Security Officer shall confirm that access controls, event monitoring, operator accounts, and security incident escalation paths are effective before revenue operation is recommended.

facts.subject: Line Traffic Controller
facts.text: The rehearsal shall demonstrate that the Line Traffic Controller can maintain safe service regulation while the Revenue Train Operator follows onboard indications and rulebook instructions.

facts.subject: null
facts.text: Acceptance for revenue service shall require completion of planned test cases, closure of safety-critical defects, successful rollback demonstration, and approval of the operations readiness record.
